title: Outer callback versus Pd process segment
scope: Original diagnostic design. No executable patch, product prototype or DAW automation.

processing_modes: generic Pd WholeBlocks only under its precondition
fixtures.input: original impulse at sample 0 and deterministic event/control sequence; use effect/utility fixtures only

procedure: Log every actual graph segment length and transport/event ordering, then measure declared and observed latency.
Compare fresh run, unrelated graph rebuild, patch replacement, rate change and release/reprepare independently.
Attempt invalid WholeBlocks segmentation only in an approved diagnostic harness and inspect rejection/silence counters.
acceptance_questions: Outer buffer divisibility does not prove segment divisibility.
Adapter latency, internal feedback delay and effect-reported latency are separately recorded.
No native/Pd equality or CPU superiority is assumed.
evidence: one-step undo and save/reopen result where applicable
authority: Current ADI decisions govern; this is test data, not an implementation.
